history.summary: Freehold 'large 1BR' (764sqft) at Alexis in D03 Queenstown for $1.1M / $1,440 PSF, a big discount to the $1,870 development median, with a reliable 4.80%/yr resale CAGR over 67 transactions and 540m to Queenstown MRT. Freehold, RCR, MRT-adjacent — a strong city-fringe value entry.
history.rating_rationale: Alexis is freehold in a prime-fringe RCR district (D03 Queenstown), 540m from Queenstown MRT (EWL), with a well-supported 4.80%/yr over 67 resale txns. The $1,440 PSF is ~23% under the $1,870 development median — even allowing that the generous 764sqft inflates the discount slightly, that gap is meaningful and suggests upside on convergence. $1.1M quantum is liquid, the unit is flexible (large 1BR / 1+study), and freehold protects the long hold. GSW/TEL momentum in the Queenstown corridor adds a catalyst. High technical score (915) corroborates.

Alexis sits above the AYE — check unit facing for road noise
1BR-class label narrows the resale buyer pool somewhat despite the size
catalysts: Freehold in D03 Queenstown — Greater Southern Waterfront corridor
~23% discount to the $1,870 development median PSF

history.summary: A real, deep-data project (67 appreciation txns) in a good forward region (D03/Queenstown, RCR ~+3.5%), and the $1,433 psf asking sits at the very bottom of the verified $1,571-$2,131 recent range - so the cheapness is plausibly real, not a quirk. But the 872 sqft 'beds:1' mismatch, thin same-size cohort (3), and documented build/quality cons (noise, mould, poor maintenance) hold this to Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Listing $1,250,000 / 872 sqft = $1,433 psf. Web confirms Alexis (FH, 2012, 293 units, 356 Alexandra Rd, D03) recent-12mo transactions $1,571-$2,131 psf (avg ~$1,859), with current PSF range $1,433-$2,180 - so $1,433 is the floor of the live range and a genuine discount to the average, supporting the -35.8% age-adj signal at the project level. D03 is a desirable RCR location atop Redhill/Tiong Bahru with ~+3.5% realized forward. Caveats: 872 sqft is large for a '1-bed' (bedroom_sqft_mismatch) suggesting a 1+study/dual-key or mis-tag; psf_cohort_txns=3 is thin so the same-size comp is weak; and reviews repeatedly cite road noise, humidity/mould and poor maintenance, plus the well-connected-but-stigma-free location is offset by an aging 2012 development.
red_flags: 872 sqft 'beds:1' mismatch - likely a 1+study/dual-key or mis-tag; verify actual layout
psf_cohort_txns=3: same-size discount rests on only 3 comparables - thin
Documented quality cons: road noise, humidity/mould, poor maintenance per resident reviews
Aging 2012 development; MCST/maintenance condition needs on-site verification
catalysts: D03 Queenstown/Alexandra: strong RCR location, good forward region (~+3.5%)
$1,433 psf is the bottom of the live $1,433-$2,180 range - real entry value if condition holds
Well-connected to the city; large 293-unit project gives deeper resale liquidity than small Geylang peers

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: appreciation_pct 4.8% (URA 5yr CAGR over a solid 67 txns) is the most data-rich of this batch, but per v3.4 trailing CAGR is not forward-predictive; the durable positives are region (D03 RCR) and verified bottom-of-range pricing, not the past CAGR.
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Avg rent ~$3.59k over past 6 months; on $1.25M that is a thin ~3.4% gross yield. Central location supports steady tenancy, but income is unexceptional - the case rests on value/region, not yield.
